name: Consorzio Patata Italiana di Qualità Soc. Cons. R.L.
note: Bologna-province consortium (Villanova di Castenaso, VAT 01522961208) that produces and markets the Selenella brand. Founded 2002 as Consorzio delle buone idee, renamed; 10 member companies (1 producer organisation, 2 cooperatives, 7 private traders) representing about 320 producers. No state or state-fund ownership: its members are private producers, cooperatives and traders.
